CLEAR THINKING. PRACTICAL EXECUTION.01 — AN INTRODUCTION
01 / ABOUT

Building capability.
Growing ownership.

I’m Nicholas, Tech Partner and Chief Technology Officer at Section in Singapore. I lead a technical organisation of more than 60 people, alongside my business partners Ryan, who leads business direction, and Eugene, who leads design and solutioning.

Since 2025, I’ve led our expansion from website and small scale technical delivery into systems integration across digital experience, customer data, engagement and CRM. That shift meant reshaping teams, building specialist practices and giving technical leaders ownership of delivery.

60+People in the technical organisation I lead
100+Professional certifications earned across 40+ team members over two years
02 / TECHNICAL DIRECTION

Expand what’s possible.
Build on what’s proven.

01

From websites to connected platforms

I look for the next useful step beyond a website: connecting experience platforms such as Sitecore with customer data, engagement and CRM. The opportunity needs to fit client demand, our business strategy and what the team can realistically take on.

02

Invest in specialist depth

I invest in professional certification and practical delivery experience together. Building that expertise in-house has helped us take on new work and rely less on external specialists.

03

Architecture that holds up in operation

Architecture choices need to account for reliability, scaling, cost and the people who will run the system. Those considerations matter as much as getting the first release out.

04

Exploring enterprise AI

I’m currently exploring enterprise AI use cases across business workflows, assessing where the technology fits and what dependable delivery would require.

04 / LEADERSHIP

Lead the first.
Enable the next.

I work alongside the team on the first engagement, then hand ownership to the people appointed to lead the practice.

01

Build depth and breadth.

I develop T-shaped teams: people with depth in a specialism and enough breadth to work across disciplines. Practice heads and project leads own technical quality and their people’s development.

02

Learn it. Deliver it together.

I go through the platform’s professional certification process myself, help win the first engagement, appoint the next lead and work with the team through delivery and stabilisation.

03

Give leaders real ownership.

Routine technical decisions stay with specialists and project leads. Escalations go through our Technical Delivery Director. We review the most complex architecture decisions together, including high availability and on-premises scaling.
